results.name: Gateoff, cancel-before-send, self review and guest return never perform a hidden RPC
Actual report handlers preserve immutable UUID/payload through cancel/reopen and exercise all four targets
Block requires confirm, suppresses repeated taps, exposes failure and refreshes only after confirmed success
Unblock cancels without action, reconciles a vanished receipt and never repeats confirmed write after refresh failure
Review consent/version guards, failed-save draft, real Query mutation repeated taps and retry remain honest
A→B→A rejects stale completion and between-await submit; B does not inherit A report intent or draft
Policy refetch errors disable publishing and actor mismatch hides private UGC views
